checks: Verified local convergence directly by ray-section interpolation, uniform inner inclusion on interior product compacts, and compactness of the original tangential projection at bounded normal height.
The common source ball bounds the optimizing parameters by denominator positivity. A fixed small dual test gives a uniform finite objective because d+1>k.

The compact denominator floor passes to the product along interior compacts and then to its boundary by continuity. Fatou yields a finite lower bound at each cluster point, with the product theorem identifying its admissible minimum.

The fixed product optimizer is uniformly positive over all actual dilated bodies: local upper tangential convergence controls bounded radii, while strict duality controls the tail. Dominated convergence gives recovery with exponent d+1.

Convergent dual normals and the compact floor yield a uniform escort majorant (1+|q|)^{-d-2}, integrable with first moments because d>=k. Scaling the normal coordinate back gives weak convergence to the tangential marginal.

For a polytope a face-exposing functional is positive on all nonzero projected vertex generators, so its finitely generated projected cone is closed and pointed. Checked source e70b63e0e6efe01c:06, (19)–(22).
